thread:
lia (AE): HealthMatrix POC ask: they want SSO (SAML) + SCIM, support for OneLogin and Google Workspace, group->role mapping with hierarchy (org/team), JIT vs full SCIM import options, and tenant binding across merged domains. They also attached a 30-page security questionnaire. Can we do a 30m pre-call tomorrow? Need answers for procurement by Friday.

omar (SE): I can join. Quick clarifiers: 1) Do they want SAML Artifact binding or just HTTP-POST/Redirect? 2) JIT provisioning use-case ok? JIT works for small orgs but for 10k users we should do bulk SCIM import.

rachel (Security): Main blockers from questionnaire: BYOK/HSM for key custody, audit retention 2 years, SCIM event webhooks to their SIEM (needs HMAC verification), IP allowlist for admin UI, and attestations for tenant isolation across M&A. If they insist on FedRAMP/HITRUST-level evidence that's a big ask.

dan (Solutions): We can demo both JIT and full SCIM. For merged domains they want domain aliasing + tenant mapping rules (map user email domain to tenant unless overridden). We also support delegated admin via RBAC (org-admin vs team-admin). Example SCIM mapping they can paste into OneLogin:```json
{
  "userName": "email",
  "name.familyName": "name.familyName",
  "name.givenName": "name.givenName",
  "groups": "groups",
  "extension:tenant_id": "urn:healthmatrix:tenant"
}
```

omar (SE): SAML metadata snippet to share:```xml
<EntityDescriptor entityID="https://healthmatrix.redwood.example/sp">
  <SPSSODescriptor protocolSupportEnumeration="urn:oasis:names:tc:SAML:2.0:protocol">
    <AssertionConsumerService Binding="urn:oasis:names:tc:SAML:2.0:bindings:HTTP-POST" Location="https://healthmatrix.redwood.example/saml/acs"/>
    <NameIDFormat>urn:oasis:names:tc:SAML:1.1:nameid-format:emailAddress</NameIDFormat>
  </SPSSODescriptor>
</EntityDescriptor>
```

lia (AE): Pricing question: will domain aliasing, SCIM webhooks, and extended audit retention force Dedicated/Private? They're mid-enterprise; procurement wants options.

dan (Solutions): Short: SCIM webhooks and mapping + JIT are supported on Hosted Enterprise for POC. BYOK/HSM and contractual extended retention typically require Dedicated or Private. Domain aliasing and tenant isolation across M&A may need org-level isolation (separate orgs) for the strongest guarantee. We can propose a hybrid: Hosted with strict routing + DNS proof for POC, Dedicated if they need SLA-backed isolation.

rachel (Security): Also need KMS proof: if they need BYOK we need to know whether they want to import keys or use external HSM via KMIP. That will determine Private requirement. Also request IdP fleet list (OneLogin/GSuite/Okta) and provisioning cadence.

omar (SE): For the merged domains case we can support automatic tenant assignment via email domain or SAML attribute `tenant` + admin override UI. For imports we support CSV/SCIM bulk and a one-time fast-import job. We'll include an example import command:```bash
# one-time CSV import (POC)
redwoodctl import users --file users.csv --tenant healthmatrix-demo
```

lia (AE): They also asked about delegated admin audit trails and ability to restrict admin by IP. Are those Hosted features?

dan (Solutions): Delegated admin + role hierarchy is in Hosted but IP allowlist on admin UI is an enterprise add-on; for strict network allowlists we recommend Dedicated or Private. Audit trails for delegated admin actions are available, but extended retention (2y+) is an add-on or Private.

rachel (Security): For the SIEM webhook please ensure HMAC signatures and retry/backoff semantics documented. We'll provide a sample webhook spec to them and they need to confirm their SIEM can verify HMAC.

omar (SE): I'll attach the webhook spec and SCIM retry semantics in the follow-up. Also adding SAML troubleshooting checklist: check cert thumbprint, clock skew, NameID format, and artifact vs post binding mismatch.

infra-bot: Demo env provisioned: healthmatrix-demo cluster active until 2024-08-15T23:59Z. Request extension via #eng-infra.

lia (AE): Action items: 1) @omar add SAML metadata + troubleshooting and webhook spec 2) @dan prepare mapping examples for OneLogin + GSuite and CSV-import steps 3) @rachel mark questionnaire answers that will force Dedicated/Private 4) I'll draft pricing: Hosted POC path vs Dedicated/Private quotes with BYOK + 2yr retention add-ons.

dan (Solutions): One more thing: they asked about OIDC fallback for service accounts and API-based tenant provisioning. We support API tenant creation and service-account OIDC tokens. Example API call:```bash
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  https://api.redwood-inference.example/v1/tenants -d '{"name":"healthmatrix-demo","domain":"demo.healthmatrix.com"}'
```

lia (AE): Good. I'll schedule the 30m pre-call and include their IdP and SIEM engineer. Please upload draft questionnaire answers into this thread after the pre-call so I can forward to procurement. :white_check_mark:
